title: Speed & Accuracy
summary: Put it all together: check answers with the inverse and with casting out nines, choose the best strategy for each calculation, and build speed with mixed sprints from every level.
bigIdeas: Fast is only useful if it is right: check every answer quickly.
The best mental mathematicians first choose the right strategy, then calculate.
tips: Check a subtraction by adding: $83 - 47 = 36$ because $36 + 47 = 83$.
Casting out nines: digit sums must agree. $47 \times 38$: $2 \times 2 = 4$, and $1786$ has digit sum $22 \to 4$.
Before you calculate, ask: is there a round number nearby, a pair that makes $100$, or a square?
Slow is smooth, smooth is fast: accuracy first, then speed.
